name: MessagePit Email and SMS Testing
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local/self-hosted email and SMS testing software with SMTP capture, SendGrid v3 API stub, Twilio-compatible SMS ingest, webhook capture, delivery-event simulation, web UI and Docker deployment; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiration.
watch_out: Unofficial Mailpit fork adding distinct SMS and provider API simulation; existing Mailpit catalog entry covers email-only testing. Intended for local/development/staging testing, not actual SMS or email delivery. Self-hosting hardware, storage, network and maintenance are user-provided; protect exposed ports and optional authentication. No free hosted infrastructure included.
